comment: Optional host toolchains installed by setup.sh --devtools and setup.sh devtools. Pins are deliberate: these are compiler/SDK installs outside the DSH data snapshot, so an update never replaces them. Android SDK packages are sdkmanager ids; the NDK and CMake versions are the AOSP defaults for the pinned platform.

ios.label: iOS (xtool)
ios.description: Swift and xtool; xtool turns a SwiftPM package into a signed iOS app without a Mac. Completing xtool setup still needs an Apple ID and an Xcode.xip downloaded from Apple.
ios.note: Xcode.xip and the Apple sign-in are interactive and licensed to you; setup installs the toolchain, not the Apple SDK.

android.label: Android
android.description: OpenJDK, Android command-line tools, platform-tools, the Android 36 platform, build-tools and the NDK. Enough to build native Android apps with Gradle; no Android Studio and no emulator.
android.note: Installing the SDK accepts the Android SDK license on this host. The emulator is not installed: it needs a desktop and KVM, and a device or CI is the normal target.
